mission: SNKRDUNK coverage, step 1 (owner 'perfectionist' 2026-11-01). Published discovery only inspects sitemap neighbours of approved SNKRDUNK mappings, all in OP-01..OP-04 and EB-01, so it stopped on 2026-10-23 ('neighbourhoods_exhausted') and 19 sets had no starting point (1,139 of 1,528 missing high-rarity prints). A committed file of 41 owner-confirmed SNKRDUNK products (2-3 per set, found with SNKRDUNK's own search) now joins the anchors: starting points only, never mappings, never priced, never identity decisions. The claim re-checks every seed against the committed file.

impacts.reason: Seeds file reader (fail closed: schema, bound 200, release/url/title/confirmed_by, distinct public product identities) and 41 seeds for OP-05..OP-17, EB-02..EB-05, PRB-01/02. The infrastructure effect is the mission-scoped release of snkrdunk-collector only.

Planner: anchors = approved mappings plus committed seeds, least used first, at most 12 per intent; pool size counts both, so new seeds end 'neighbourhoods_exhausted'. Cursor gains anchor_seed_identities. intent(): 1..12 anchors across both kinds, seeds must still be in the committed file. Bounds unchanged (radius 48, 20 products, request cost 300).

Seeds restart exhausted discovery and come before used mappings; a seed removed from the file is refused at claim; the committed file is valid; bad files fail closed. Full SNKRDUNK suite 672 passed on local Postgres 16.

routes: Same published discovery route as before (robots, sitemap index, retained shards, up to 20 product pages per intent); no new route
impact.deployment_impact: snkrdunk-collector re-uploaded on the merge commit with automatic rollback. Behaviour change: auto discovery resumes (about 4 intents a day, each up to 20 product pages, about 100 requests) around the seeds; new products become candidates only.

recovery.procedure: The rollout captures snkrdunk-collector's live deployment before upload and restores it on failure (recovery_deployment_id is reference only); afterwards collector-redeploy to the fleet pin. Code: native revert PR with its own mission file.
recovery.trigger: Discovery intents failing on the new code, a source denial, or storage growth above the 100-250 MB one-off estimate (plan/new-sources §4).
recovery.backup: Not applicable: no schema change; observations are append-only.

verification.observation_window: Delivery verify; then snkrdunk-discovery-state shows new auto-v1 intents with anchor_seed_identities and new_candidates > 0; storage-rates within the 45-day watch.
